notes.title: 🧹 One Man’s Trash - Game Modes Update
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598516/2b5e9a2d05851af34e6052a68b972266542b3ff1.png"][/img]🚨 [b]Spoiler Warning:[/b][/p][p]This post reveals gameplay systems, item mechanics, and late-game content. Prefer to discover things yourself? Now’s the time to stop scrolling.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 New Difficulty Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]🛋 Cozy Mode[/b]
A relaxed experience:
• No enemies
• Coupons never expire — use them anytime
• Perfect for chill diggers and explorers[/p][p][/p][p][b]🧹 Classic Mode[/b] [i](Default)[/i]
The tried-and-true setup:
• Enemies spawn deep underground
• Coupons expire shortly after pickup
• Balanced and faithful to the core experience[/p][p][/p][p][b]🕳 Abyss Mode[/b]
For the brave (or foolish):
• No central rope — escape is up to you
• Enemies hit harder
• Coupons can be stored like in Cozy
• A true descent into madness[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🐛 Pet Worm Overhaul[/h3][p]Your loyal worm now [b]consumes trash from your vacuum’s dustbag[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🏆 New Achievement[/h3][p][b]💀 No Way Up[/b]
Complete a full run in Abyss Mode.
Only the toughest (or most stubborn) diggers will make it out alive.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][p]• Minor bug fixes[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Dig deep. Stay sharp. Feed the worm.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Tag us on socials or join the community:[/b] 
👉 [url="https://discord.com/invite/fCR7a99yWG"]Join the Discord[/url] – share finds, bugs, screenshots, memes, and your wildest holes.
[b]
Jony Pazu[/b]
[i]Solo Dev[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🚀 One Man’s Trash is OUT NOW! Vacuum, Dig, Profit.
notes.notes:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598516/2b5e9a2d05851af34e6052a68b972266542b3ff1.png"][/img]🧹 It's Time. Let's Suck.[/h1][p][b]One Man’s Trash[/b] is now officially released on [b]Steam[/b]!
Grab your vacuum. The junkyard is yours.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]💡 What Is This Game?[/h2][p]A true story meets a fever dream:
You’re a washed-up crypto bro who just blew his last cash on a sketchy junkyard.
[b]Why?[/b] To dig for a lost hard drive containing [b]8,000 PitCoin[/b]. That’s over [b]$100 million[/b].[/p][p]Armed with a janky vacuum, your only choice is [b]down[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🌀 Suck. Sell. Upgrade. Go Deeper.[/h2][p]📺 Find cursed items, pop culture relics, and tons of trash.
💎 Unlock vacuum skins, earn achievements, and master the pit.
👁️‍🗨️ Something is lurking deep below. You’ve been warned.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠 What's in the Launch Version?[/h2][p]Here’s just some of what’s waiting for you:[/p][list][*][p]💻 [b]Full upgrade system[/b] (vacuum power, size, rope length, inventory, tools)[/p][/*][*][p]🗑 [b]60+ collectible items[/b] across 3 tiers: [i]Trash, Rare, and Secret Locations[/i][/p][/*][*][p]🎰 [b]Three in-game websites[/b]: Junkbay, Junkazon, Junkasino[/p][/*][*][p]🧭 [b]Discover hidden locations[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Controller support[/b] + customizable keyboard mapping[/p][/*][*][p]📦 [b]Trophy pedestals[/b] and achievement tracking[/p][/*][*][p]🧟‍♂ [b]Enemies and hazards[/b] deeper down (don’t ask)[/p][/*][*][p]🧹 [b]Vacuum skins[/b] to unlock[/p][/*][*][p]🎯 [b]One ultimate goal[/b]: [i]Find the drive.[/i]
[i](If it even exists…)[/i][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🗣 We Want to See Your Trash[/h2][p]Please share your:[/p][p]🤯 Best vacuum builds
😂 Funniest screenshots
🐛 Bug reports (yes please)
😱 Ridiculous pit escapes
💀 Horrible deaths by falling or… other things[/p][p][b]Tag us on socials or join the community:[/b]
👉 [url="https://discord.com/invite/fCR7a99yWG"]Join the Discord[/url] – share finds, bugs, screenshots, memes, and your wildest holes.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🧡 Thank You[/h2][p]This game was built entirely solo over months of vacuum-induced madness.
Huge thanks to everyone who played the demo, gave feedback, wishlisted, or shared it online.[/p][p][b]You made this possible.[/b]
[b]Let’s dig.[/b][/p][p][b]Jony Pazu[/b]
[i]Solo Dev, Vacuum Enthusiast[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🚧 One Man’s Trash – Public Demo Updated & July Release Incoming!
notes.notes:
Big things are happening in the junkyard! The [b]public demo[/b] of [b]One Man’s Trash[/b] just received a major update – with more to explore, new systems to uncover, and your first glimpse of what’s coming in the full game.
📆 Full release planned for [b]July 2025[/b]
 🧡 Wishlist now to support the launch and stay in the loop!

🔧 What’s New in the Demo:
🗂️ [b]Collection System[/b]
 Rare items now glow and can be displayed in your Trophy Room. Discover hidden locations and build your collection!
🔒 [b]Locked Vitrines[/b]
 Find and unlock special vacuum skins by completing item and location sets.
📻 [b]Radio System[/b]
 You can now turn on the radio and switch between multiple music tracks – or turn it off if you prefer the silence.

🛠️ [b]Plus:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced item values & upgrade costs
[*] Improved overheating mechanics
[*] Carry two special items instead of one
[*] Added credits page
[*] Tons of bug fixes and polish
[/list]

Whether you're returning to the junkyard or diving in for the first time: now’s the perfect time to experience the updated demo – and get hyped for the full game in July!
👉 [b]Add One Man’s Trash to your wishlist now and don’t miss the release![/b]

notes.title: One Man's Trash: Free Demo Is Out Now – Start Digging!
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to the Junkyard![/b]

The wait is over. The FREE demo of [b]One Man’s Trash[/b] is now live! Play as a washed-up crypto bro turned junkyard explorer in a desperate (and ridiculous) quest to find your lost [i]PitCoin[/i] hard drive – worth over a million bucks. Yeah, you heard that right.

🚀 [b]What’s new in the demo?[/b]
🌍 Multi-language support for more global trash diggers!
🎰 [b]New:[/b] The [i]Junkasino[/i] – blow your hard-earned scrap cash on high-stakes junk slots.
✨ More [b]Special Items[/b] to spice up your dig – power boosts, sell bonuses, rare finds, and more.
🐛 Sinister surprises await deeper in the pit... something’s rumbling.

💡 Game Features:

Absorb trash with your trusty vacuum – dig deeper and discover more.
Sell items, upgrade your gear, discover secrets, and survive the pit.
Rare finds like the Holy Grail and a totally unsuspicious sandwich? Yes. Totally normal stuff.

Get in now, before someone else finds the hard drive!

🕹️ [b]Download the Free Demo & start digging today! And if you like it, put it on your wishlist[/b]
